# Mırıl

> Mırıl is a free Android app for adults and teens (13+) who are trying to quit smoking: a gentle cat sits beside you, and your daily check-ins become pages in a cozy notebook, without streaks, shame or pressure.

> Mırıl, sigarayı bırakmaya çalışan 13 yaş ve üzeri herkes için ücretsiz bir Android uygulamasıdır: yanında yargılamayan bir kedi oturur, günlük check-in'lerin sıcacık bir defterde sayfa olur; seri, suçluluk ya da baskı yoktur.

## Facts

- Price: free. Ads only if the user taps "Watch an ad"; never on screens that help you quit.
- Platform: Android (Google Play, closed testing at the time of writing). Languages: Turkish, English. Age: 13+.
- Counters show total smoke-free days and cigarettes not smoked; nothing resets, no streaks.
- Privacy: notebook stored encrypted on the phone, no analytics, no account needed; optional Google sign-in backup.
- Not a medical device or a treatment.
- Developer: Foxel Apps & Games · hardsteelgames@gmail.com
